selection.quote: “Motor vehicle” means every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails. The term does not include an electric bicycle or an electric scooter.
selection.reason: The definition denotes an extensional set of road users, self-propelled non-rail vehicles less named exclusions, which the ru.* classes can classify.
